specs.Picture Quality Enhancement Technology: Acer ComfyView, Acer Vision Care (Bluelight Shield, Flickerless)

features: 【🌈 23.8” Full HD VA Display with Vibrant Colors】Enjoy sharp, immersive visuals on a 23.8-inch Full HD (1920×1080) VA panel with deep contrast and 99% sRGB color coverage, delivering vibrant, lifelike colors and wide 178° viewing angles for consistent clarity from any position.

【⚡ 144Hz Refresh Rate & 1ms VRB Response】Experience ultra-smooth motion and faster screen response with a high 144Hz refresh rate and 1ms Visual Response Boost, reducing motion blur, ghosting, and input lag during fast-paced gaming and video playback.

【🎮 AMD FreeSync】Enabling smooth gameplay, Eliminating screen tearing, Minimizing lag and latency I With FreeSync, the monitor’s frames are synced with the graphics card’s frames, which eliminates screen tearing and delivers very smooth gaming experiences.

【🔌 HDMI & VGA Connectivity】Connect easily with HDMI 1.4 and VGA ports, offering compatibility with PCs, laptops, gaming consoles, and legacy devices while supporting Full HD resolution up to 144Hz via HDMI.

【👁️ Acer VisionCare Eye Comfort】Built with Flicker-less, BlueLightShield, Low-Dimming, and ComfyView technologies to help reduce eye strain and provide comfortable viewing during long work or gaming sessions.
